document: IStructE/Concrete Society SMDS Ch5-6 — Drawing Conventions

layer_notation.note: Reinforcement fixed from bottom upward; bar marks should follow same sequence

typical_bar_representation_on_plan.one_bar: 1H10-63-T1 — single thick line with mark indicator
typical_bar_representation_on_plan.zone_of_three_or_more: 20H10-63-150T1 — thick line with dot at junction; first/last bars shown as short thick lines with arrowheads at extent
typical_bar_representation_on_plan.bends_or_hooks: represented by medium dot at end of typical bar
typical_bar_representation_on_plan.bars_detailed_elsewhere: thick dashed line with SEE DRG note
typical_bar_representation_on_plan.space_restricted: calling up within indicator line zone
typical_bar_representation_on_plan.fan_zone_from_radius: indicator line on datum radius; note s.o.p (setting out point)

fixing_dimensions.description: Dimensions (mm) required by steel-fixer to locate bars not controlled by end covers
fixing_dimensions.dimension_line_style: thin lines terminated by short obliques (not arrowheads)

bars_in_elevation.first_last_in_zone: dot in section with appropriate mark
bars_in_elevation.curtailed_bars: short 30° obliques with mark; pointers if congested

bars_of_varying_length.schedule_entry: different lengths allocated to each suffix

bars_in_long_panels.method: identical bars of convenient length lapped end to end; state minimum lap

fabric_on_plan.each_sheet: given mark number; relate to concrete outline; indicate main reinforcement direction and layer
fabric_on_plan.lap_location: away from high tensile force regions; stagger sheets
fabric_on_plan.lap_dimensions: shown on plan or as note

plan.purpose: main reinforcement layout, bar runs, spacing, extent

view_types_slab.key_plan: small diagram showing bay references and section cuts

features: Plan with bar runs in both directions
Top bars (T1, T2) and bottom bars (B1, B2) on same plan
U-bars shown at edges with 'U-BARS' or 'U-BARS LONG LEG B1' notation
Quantities in brackets showing per-bay counts: (2), (4), (16)
Section markers 1-1, 2-2, 3-3 etc. with cross-sections showing bar marks
AP (alternately placed) notation
AS (alternately staggered) notation
Reference to wall drawing: SEE WALL DRG R006
Dimension callouts for group extents: 250, 450, 500, 1000mm
Column strip and middle strip zones visible
Concentrated column-strip bars with closer bar spacing than middle strip
Sections 1-1, 2-2 showing bar arrangements at column and mid-span
Key plan showing bay references (A, B, C) and sections
AP (alternately placed) notation for alternating bars
Dimension callouts: 600, 700, 1200, 1500, 50mm for column strip concentration
Plan showing '2 PER RIB' notation for rib bars
Sections 1-1 and 2-2 showing rib cross-section and topping
Cover callouts: '25 CVR TO 14', '15 CVR TO 13'
Mesh layer with 'MESH' label
Links shown in rib cross-sections with bar marks

traditional_method.description: Individual beams drawn related to specific grid lines; used where little repetition
elevation_features: Total link count: '37 H12 07 LINKS P.A.S + 29 H12 08 300 LINK CLOSERS'
Hanger bars and main bars labeled
Reference to slab and other beams: 'SEE SLAB DRG', 'SEE BEAMS DRG No R010'
cross_section_features: Slab bars shown schematically: 'SEE SLAB DRG'
Two section positions showing different link arrangements

representational_method.description: General beam elevation + specific cross-sections + table; for repetitive beams
features: General elevation showing zones labeled by letter (A, B, C, D, E, L1, L2, L3)
Bar location letters cross-reference elevation to table
Fixing dimensions DIM 1, DIM 2 labeled in elevation and cross-referenced to table
Table with columns: BEAM, DIM 1, DIM 2, A, B, C, D, E, L1, L2, L3, SECTION, SECTION
Key plan showing beam positions (BEAM A, BEAM B, BEAM C) relative to grid

broad_beam_method.description: For wide shallow beams with multiple bars side by side
features: Elevation showing zones 1, 2, 3 with bar notation
Links shown as '22 H10 09 + 44 H10 10 LINKS IN 3s PAS. PLUS 18 H10 11 300 CLOSERS'
U-bars at supports: '5 H20 04 UB'
Multiple cross-sections 1-1, 2-2, 3-3 showing different bar arrangements
Bars shown with actual positions: 07, 04, 04, 07 / 0708 0808 0807

link_notation.total_notation: e.g. '37 H12 07 LINKS P.A.S' (P.A.S = placed as shown)

beam_drawing_conventions.u_bar_notation: UB suffix on bar notation (e.g. '2 H20 02 UB')
beam_drawing_conventions.te_suffix: TEF = top EF (top each face), used for side/face bars
